subject: Printer not working - blank receipts printing
description: The printer is broken. It's printing blank receipts and we cannot issue customer receipts. This is a major issue. Please fix ASAP. The machine is in the counter area.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and assigned. Attempted to gather more details from submitter regarding error codes, paper status, and recent maintenance history but received no response.
Attempted basic troubleshooting call to store but line was busy. Scheduled follow-up for morning shift to verify printer connectivity and paper supply status.
